title: Component
description: A Component is a named, reusable UI unit within a Section (e.g. a card, table, or form). It maps from a Resource and optionally an Operation, and composes Elements.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the component.

type.description: The structural type of the component.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of what this component does.

operation.description: The Operation this component maps from, expressed as Resource.Action.

elements.description: The Elements composed within this component, in order.
